Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
9:26 PM

The National Museum (Janpath, New Delhi) is open Tue–Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today is Monday, so the next chance is tomorrow, Tue 27 Oct, 10:00 AM.

Tickets

Adults: ₹20
Foreign nationals: ₹500
Students up to class 12: free with an I-card

The site has a note from May 2023 saying the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries were closed for renovation. It may be out of date, so check before you go if those matter to you.
